Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

We offer a price of €370.96 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. 

Regarding our cost structure, CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost.

Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG

move.subject: Re: Nordmark passes on copper for the 7.5 kW motor
move.body:
Dear Petra Lechner,

We acknowledge your offer and the cost-index movements you have provided. We recognise that larger adjustments require management approval and request a revision within your delegated authority, focusing on extended payment terms and a price adjustment supported by the stated cost drivers.

1. Volume and term: we confirm a binding volume of 6,110 units per year for 12 months, 6,110 units in total.
2. Our proposal: EUR 361.96 per unit, 90 days net, no price-adjustment clause. This amounts to about EUR 2,211,576 over the term.
3. Basis: Our demand forecast for this part is up +11.9% (fc:350011@2026-09), and we commit 6,110 units a year. Producer prices DE: basic iron and steel, ferro-alloys changed -4.3% from 2024-10 to 2025-10 (idx:PPI-C241@2024-10, idx:PPI-C241@2025-10).
4. Next step: All other terms as in your quote; on your written confirmation of these terms we will issue the order.

Attached: our monthly call-off schedule for the full contract term.

Kind regards,
Purchasing, Hollerau Pumpenwerke

move.text:
Dear Sir or Madam,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We acknowledge the verified decrease in the PPI-C241 index and your increased volume commitment, which allows us to adjust our pricing. CU-NOTATION rose 47.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 20 % of our cost. That remains. PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 14 % of our cost. That remains. Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal. Extending payment terms to 90 days would necessitate a price increase, so we must revert to 30 days net to offer a lower unit price. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to?

Our Angebot stands at a price of €372.52 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, no Preisgleitklausel. Based on these factors, we propose a revised price of €368.42 per unit at 30 days net. This alternative package offers a price of €368.42 per unit, Zahlungsziel 30 days net, no Preisgleitklausel at standard terms. 

This offer remains valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Petra Lechner
Key Account Manager, Antriebstechnik Nordmark AG
